alike are waiting at the Temple for word of your adventure and the Jewel.

expedition.

You are the only member of any party to have returned."

"The only one?" you say with alarm.

different people that are in attendance. Some are old, some are children; some 
are wealthy estate owners, others poor beggars. Your sights, however, become 
transfixed on one group: a group of five adventurers who can't be a day older 
than twenty-one. A banner that one of them carries reads:

"Jewel Expedition No. 94"

in search of the Jewel. Your stomach sinks a little bit, and you begin your 
speech.

geyser, a flooding river, and a magical coat that saved your skin on more than 
one occasion. You tell them about three fearsome dragons and how much you've
